items.title: Tuts Washington Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: I hear some of his records, he's good, man.

ctx.x: A little brother man, I've been knowing him for years. When did you meet him the first time and where? Oh man that was back in the thirties. Not earlier. It might have been in the 29 man. Around before the thirties. It was before the thirties. Oh yeah. It was before the thirties when I met little brother. Let me see now. It's been so long. His last name is Montgomery. That's right. That's right. That was way back in the 20s. You can remember that. In the 20s. Yeah. It was in the 20s. He used to live right around…

Oh yeah you know I think he died left back or left here At which time did he leave? Oh I don't know exactly when he left because I was quite young and I didn't keep up with him I couldn't keep up with him at that time, I was a real young kid All the time I seen him when he came to my house You know little brother knew him too? Yeah brother knew him Brother was an old piano player from around here Yeah brother was around here along playing around here in my time He came up with you? Around in my time he was…
I have to walk, keep getting too sick. I never heard of him either.
